Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong second half and full year for financial year 2026, driven primarily by the water technologies segment while construction and distribution rebounded after monsoon disruptions. Consolidated revenue reached Rs. 326.15 crores with improved EBITDA and profit before tax. However, management noted margin pressures in the current period due to sharp increases in raw material and metal-based input costs. They expressed positive growth outlooks across business units supported by new customer acquisitions, order books, and strategic approvals.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook continues to remain positive.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

guidance.claim: Management expects approximately 15 to 20 percent volume growth in construction chemicals for quarter one.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: Management estimates roughly around 10 percent volume growth for water chemicals.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

guidance.claim: The company expects the second half of the financial year to perform at a steady growth rate.
guidance.quote: So we hope H2 would be we also be growing at a steady rate.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates achieving the Rs. 1000 crore milestone in about four years.
guidance.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved. Of course, there are a lot of external factors, but we hope to be on course to get there.

guidance.claim: The water business is projected to grow at a rate of 10 to 15% year on year.
guidance.quote: So we see a steady growth of seven to 8% in the market, but we would probably grow at a rate of 10 to 15% year on year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the water business is starting the financial year with a strong order book for chemicals and equipment systems.
demand_outlook.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also. Equipment systems are of course on the order book we have, but even the chemicals we have contracts running till late in this financial year before they come up for renewal.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a robust enquiry pipeline in the Water BU.
Management reported 18% stronger demand in Construction Chemicals.
Management noted a healthy and ongoing enquiry pipeline in the water technologies business.
demand_outlook.quote: we have a healthy enquiry pipeline which is ongoing.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction chemicals business trend is on the growing side following monsoon-related disruptions.
demand_outlook.quote: The sales are mostly affected by a monsoon. Prolonged monsoon had affected our sales but the trend is now on the growing side.

demand_outlook.claim: The revenue outlook remains positive across all business units including construction, chemical distribution, and cleaning and hygiene.
demand_outlook.quote: our outlook remains positive across all business units. That is construction, chemical distribution and cleaning and hygiene.

capex_expansion.claim: Management explained that the increase in capital expenditure figures for the year primarily reflects the full year impact of the demerger and incoming assets.
capex_expansion.quote: I think what primarily is the full year of impact of the demerger. So some of the assets that were on the common books and could not have been very critically identified or tagged, they have started coming in.

margins_costs.claim: Management observed that material costs started increasing from the end of February and March.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that in the immediate month, they saw about a 3 percent impact on margins due to haywire input costs.
margins_costs.quote: The total impact is, I mean, I don't know whether I can give you up to the day updates. But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that employee cost accounts for almost 18 percent of their top line.
margins_costs.quote: So a lot of our cost, if you look at about almost 18% of our top line is into employee cost as opposed to, you know, 14% or something like that in the other businesses.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Management mentioned material costs increase due to war impact, with some volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA increased due to good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Improved margins were supported by lower raw material costs and newly introduced product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in

orders_capacity.claim: Management highlighted that water technologies is their largest operating segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water technologies is by far the largest.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported a strong order book for specialty chemicals in the Water BU.
orders_capacity.quote: Strong order book for specialty chemicals

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that equipment and systems deliveries are on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: The water business unit holds a new order book of almost Rs. 100 plus crores apart from regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the new water business order book, about Rs. 85 to 90 crores is in the chemical domain and Rs. 10 to 12 crores in the equipment domain.
orders_capacity.quote: almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they are maintaining a tight credit policy with days sales outstanding around 88 days for construction chemicals.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that about 30 percent of their water business comes from public sector units and none accepted force majeure until recently declared by the government.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that construction and distribution businesses faced slowdowns in the first half due to prolonged monsoon impacts.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you'll see, the first half of both the construction and the distribution businesses were low and we mentioned last time that the 15% decrease that you see here is primarily the first half, the pro longed monsoon.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted a prolonged monsoon affecting Construction Chemicals activity, which picked up post monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

risks_headwinds.claim: Summer chemical sales were negatively impacted because of the prolonged monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this year, unfortunately, because of the prolonged monsoon, the summer chemicals could not be sold.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sluggish growth in the industrial end-market and delayed projects impacted equipment business invoicing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second is that there has been a sluggish growth in the end on the industrial front in which we operate some of the projects have been delayed quite a lot and we could not invoice those projects which are getting. Wise to slowly this year, especially in the equipment business.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they intend to bring the portion of total revenue coming from the water business a little lower over time.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to bring the portion of the total pie a little lower, but in the financial year, this is the fastest growing business.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to hold analyst and investor meetings twice a year.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to have these twice in a year. So this is for the half year and we intend to also have one later on, towards the year financial year end.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
